DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Bronchitis.

The normal CBC rules out severe bacterial pneumonia, and the chest X-ray showing only increased bronchial markings and cuffing without consolidation is classic for acute bronchitis. The yellowish sputum is likely due to inflammation rather than a severe bacterial infection. I recommend rest, increased fluid intake, and possibly a short course of a cough suppressant if the cough becomes bothersome at night. Please return if you develop a high fever, worsening shortness of breath, or coughing up blood.
